1	# NINEONELABS Codex Guide
2	
3	Use this file for Codex-specific repo instructions. Keep Claude-specific behavior in `CLAUDE.md`.
4	
5	## Project Defaults
6	
7	- Stack: TypeScript, SCSS, Three.js, Vite, PHP 7.4 custom MVC, MySQL, Apache via Docker
8	- Dev server: `http://localhost:8888`
9	- Default task framing: state the goal, relevant context, constraints, and done condition.
10	- For complex or ambiguous work, plan first before editing code.
11	- Prefer `chop` for long git, typecheck, and Docker inspection output when available.
12	- For read-only `git` inspection commands that may produce non-trivial output, prefer `chop` by default.
13	- Typical examples: `chop git status`, `chop git diff`, `chop git log --oneline -20`.
14	- Prefer `chop rg ...` for repository searches when the result may be longer than a few lines.
15	- For PowerShell builtins or pipeline-based inspection commands, wrap the whole script with `chop powershell -Command "..."`.
16	- Typical examples: `chop powershell -Command "Get-Content ... | Select-Object -Skip 720 -First 90"` and `chop powershell -Command "Get-Content ... | Select-String ..."`.
17	- Very short one-line commands may skip `chop`, but when in doubt prefer `chop`.
18	- Do not run `npm run build` or `npm run watch`; frontend assets rebuild automatically on save.
19	- Do not add `npm run build` or `npm run watch` to agent roles, task plans, verification steps, or PR notes unless the user explicitly asks for it.
20	- On Windows PowerShell, use explicit UTF-8 for Korean text reads and writes.
21	
22	## Architecture
23	
24	- Public routes stay closure-based in `routes/web.php` and render via `render()`.
25	- Do not reintroduce Barba.js or SPA navigation contracts.
26	- Do not duplicate ownership already handled by `AppManager`, `PageRuntime`, or `PageTheatreBinder`.
27	- Keep shared engine or runtime code out of page folders.
28	- Put page scene code in `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`.
29	- Put Theatre bindings in `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`.
30	- Keep shared types in `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts`.
31	
32	## Editing Rules
33	
34	- Follow existing custom MVC patterns; do not introduce Laravel or Symfony conventions.
35	- Use BEM-style naming in SCSS.
36	- Keep admin CSS and JS separate from the public SCSS pipeline.
37	- For SCSS responsive sizing, prefer shared abstract helpers such as `fluid(...)` instead of ad-hoc raw values when the project already uses that pattern.
38	- Use `#{fluid(...)}` only inside shared `abstract` or `base` files when emitting CSS custom properties or shared tokens.
39	- In component, layout, and page SCSS files, use `fluid(min, max)` directly instead of `#{fluid(...)}`.
40	- In SCSS files outside `resource/scss/abstract/` and `resource/scss/base/`, add `@use "../abstract" as *;` at the top before using shared helpers like `fluid(...)`.
41	- Do not use CSS variable fallbacks like `var(--token, fallback)` in SCSS. Use either `var(--token)` or `fluid(...)` directly.
42	- Do not introduce base/root tokens unless the value is genuinely shared across multiple features. Avoid token waste for one-off component values.
43	- For reusable SCSS values, define the source of truth in the shared `abstract` or `base` layer first, then reference it from component or page partials.
44	- Prefer semantic tokens over raw hex values when an upstream token exists.
45	- Dispose Three.js geometries, materials, and textures.
46	- Avoid object creation inside render loops.
47	- Match event listener registration with cleanup.
48	- Never hardcode credentials or secrets.
49	
50	## Verification
51	
52	- TypeScript: `chop node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`
53	- PHP lint: `docker compose exec web php -l <file>`
54	- Diff inspection: `chop git diff`
55	- Do not use `npm run build` or `npm run watch` for verification; saved files are already handled by the automatic build flow.
56	- After changes, run the smallest relevant verification and report any checks not run.
57	- Review the final diff for regressions, risky patterns, and missing tests before handing off.
58	
59	## Repo Skills
60	
61	- `$scene-explorer`: inspect Three.js scene structure, Theatre bindings, and runtime ownership
62	- `$php-explorer`: inspect routes, render chains, admin structure, and backend ownership
63	
64	## Codex Notes
65	
66	- Repo-specific config lives in `.codex/config.toml`.
67	- Repo-specific execution policy lives in `.codex/rules/default.rules`.
68	- Repo hooks are intentionally omitted here because Codex hooks are currently disabled on Windows.
69	- Direct terminal commands are not auto-wrapped; use `chop <command>` explicitly when you want compressed output.
70	- Keep this file concise and durable. Add new rules only after repeated friction or repeated mistakes.
71	- Put stable repo rules here; use skills for repeatable workflows and MCP only when external, fast-changing context is required.

276	## 🚢 배포
277	
278	### 서버 배포 시 주의사항
279	
280	**중요**: 서버 배포 시 `vendor/` 폴더가 프로젝트에 포함되어야 합니다.
281	
282	```bash
283	# 1. 프로덕션 빌드
284	npm run build
285	
286	# 2. Composer 패키지 설치 (vendor/ 폴더 생성)
287	make composer
288	# 또는
289	composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
290	
291	# 3. 프로젝트 전체를 서버에 업로드
292	# - vendor/ 폴더 포함
293	# - node_modules/ 폴더는 제외 가능 (프론트엔드 빌드 결과물만 필요)
294	```
295	
296	### 배포 시 포함해야 할 파일/폴더
297	
298	- ✅ `vendor/` - Composer 패키지 (필수)
299	- ✅ `resource/dist/` - 빌드된 JavaScript/CSS
300	- ✅ 모든 PHP 파일

302	- ❌ `node_modules/` - 서버에서 불필요 (로컬 빌드만 필요)
303	
304	### 서버에서 Composer 설치 (선택사항)

306	서버에 Composer가 설치되어 있다면:
307	
308	```bash
309	# 서버에서 직접 설치
310	composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
311	```
312	
313	하지만 **권장 방법**은 로컬에서 `make composer` 실행 후 `vendor/` 폴더를 함께 배포하는 것입니다.

## Audit Report: Claude Code Workflow Patterns - NINEONELABS Renewal

I've completed a thorough audit of the project. Here's my comprehensive findings:

---

## 1. `.claude/rules/` Directory - COMPLETE

**Files present:** 3 files

### `frontend.md`
- Vite + TypeScript (ES6+)
- Three.js patterns required
- **Prohibition:** No `npm run build` or `npm run watch` (dev server always running)
- **Type Rules:** All types → `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts` only (no inline types, no `any`)
- **Constants:** All go to config files only (no magic numbers)
- **Three.js Disposal:** Required for every geometry, material, texture
- **Object Creation:** No object creation inside render loop
- **Event Listeners:** Must have matching `removeEventListener`
- **No Monkey-patching:** Three.js API off-limits

### `php.md`
- Framework: Custom MVC (PHP 7.4) — NOT Laravel/Symfony
- **Namespaces:** Core, Database, Http, Routing, View, Menu
- **Naming:** PascalCase classes, camelCase methods/vars, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants
- **DB Prefix:** `nb_` for all tables (e.g., `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_admin`)
- **Migration Requirement:** Schema changes MUST use migration files (`make m`), never direct ALTER

### `scss.md`
- **Pattern:** BEM naming
- **Source:** `resource/scss/` → compiled to `resource/dist/`
- **Build:** Do NOT run build commands (dev server reflects changes on save)
- **Token Contract:** Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc.; no raw hex when semantic token exists
- **Separation:** Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) stays separate from public SCSS

---

## 2. `routes/web.php` - Routing Patterns

**Route Architecture:** Closure-based (NOT controller-class MVC)

**Key Routes:**
- **Home:** GET `/` → render `pages.index`
- **About:** GET `/about` → render `pages.about.index`
- **Works:** GROUP `/works`
  - GET `/` → `pages.works.index` (with view state: scatter/grid)
  - GET `/list` → JSON API (pagination)
  - GET `/view/{no}` → detail view
  - GET `/modal/{no}` → modal view
  - GET `/modal-component/{no}` → component-only HTML
- **Careers:** GROUP `/careers`
- **Inside (News/Insight):** GROUP `/inside`
  - Lists with category & search filtering
  - Nested views and detail pages
  - Prev/next navigation
- **Contact:** GET & POST `/contact`
- **Legal:** GET `/legal/privacy`, `/legal/terms`

**Handler Pattern:** Static closures with validation functions (`$resolvePositiveInt`, `$resolveWorksView`, etc.)

---

## 3. TypeScript Architecture - `resource/ts/`

**Entry Point:** `resource/ts/app.ts` (bootstrap + deferred init via `AppManager`)

**Directory Structure:**
```
resource/ts/
├── app.ts                 # Main entry point
├── app/                   # Setup modules (Env, Object, Resize, UI)
├── core/                  # Engine, AppBootstrap, PageTheatreBinder
├── manager/               # AppManager (65KB!), BackgroundManager, others
├── runtime/               # Shared runtimes (AppOrbit, Timeline, ScrollScene, PageBoot, etc.)
├── pages/                 # Page-specific code
│   ├── main/scene/       # Main scene configs
│   ├── main/theatre/     # Main Theatre bindings
│   ├── about/scene/
│   ├── about/theatre/
│   ├── contact/scene/
│   ├── contact/theatre/
│   └── works/            # (likely similar structure)
├── objects/              # 3D scene objects
├── components/           # UI components (Button, Category, CustomCursor, Marquee, Toast, etc.)
├── types/                # All TypeScript types (18 .types.ts files)
├── builder/              # TimelineBuilder
├── animation/            # Animation classes (BlockReveal, SceneShake, TextReveal)
├── api/                  # API functions (getWork)
├── config/               # Config files (dom.config, etc.)
├── controller/           # Controllers (PageController, IntroController)
├── lib/                  # Utilities/libraries
├── ui/                   # UI classes (HudPanel, Panel, IntroOverlay)
├── utils/                # Helpers (Aria, Helpers, ScrollLock, Logger, FrameScheduler)
└── validation/           # Validation functions
```

**Types Centralization:** 18 dedicated `.types.ts` files in `resource/ts/types/`:
- `about.types.ts`, `contact.types.ts`, `main.types.ts`, `work.types.ts`
- `runtime.types.ts`, `engine.types.ts`, `core.types.ts`, `object.types.ts`
- `theatre.types.ts`, `gsap.types.ts`, `component.types.ts`, etc.

**Scene Structure Pattern:**
- `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/` — scene configs
- `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/` — Theatre.js bindings

**Three.js Lifecycle:** AppManager handles init, disposal via `AppManager.disposeBootstrap()` on beforeunload

---

## 4. `AGENTS.md` - Codex-Specific Instructions

**Location:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\AGENTS.md` (72 lines)

- **No npm run build/watch** in agent roles or verification steps

**Architecture Constraints:**
- Public routes: closure-based in `routes/web.php` with `render()`
- Do NOT reintroduce Barba.js or SPA navigation
- Page scene → `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`
- Theatre bindings → `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`
- Shared code OUT of page folders
